instruction: A candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In a bright indoor art studio with a black folding screen, the woman in the beige shirt (R2) stands on the left, looking skeptically at the man in the pink t-shirt (R1) on the right. The man stands looking down at a cherry blossom ink painting on the table with a gentle smile. They stand side-by-side, hands resting near the artwork. Soft, warm indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the pastel tones of their clothing.
